decks.notes: This Bant Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent quickly. The main strategy involves playing powerful flying creatures like Nadu and Plagon, supported by cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Noble Hierarch to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Force of Will and Daze provide protection and interaction, while cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending help deal with threats. The deck aims to establish early board presence and maintain pressure through efficient beatdown tactics.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting opponents with cards like Stifle, Daze, and Force of Will. By utilizing efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control of the board. The inclusion of Murktide Regent provides a powerful late-game threat, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help to ensure consistent draws. With a strong mana base and a mix of disruptive and aggressive elements, this deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively.

The key concept of this deck is to assemble the combo pieces needed to cast Doomsday and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck uses a combination of card draw, tutors, and fast mana to set up the Doomsday pile that will allow you to win the game in a single turn. The strategy involves disrupting your opponent's game plan with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will while building towards your own win condition. This deck aims to quickly combo off and win before the opponent can establish their own board presence.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures through cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with Animate Dead. The key strategy is to reanimate high-impact creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also uses disruption like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the game. Overall, the goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and reanimate creatures to win the game before the opponent can stop you.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By playing efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler backed up by countermagic like Force of Will, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Questing Druid to maintain card advantage and mana efficiency. With a low mana curve and a focus on tempo, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and close out matches quickly.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by combining Death & Taxes strategy with powerful creatures and disruptive cards. It utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for added value. The deck includes cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares for disruption and removal, along with powerful creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Solitude. Stoneforge Mystic and Kaldra Compleat provide equipment support, while Wasteland and Karakas disrupt opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to pressure opponents early on while controlling the board with disruptive elements.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of powerful creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure opponents. With a strong focus on mana efficiency and disruption, Death & Taxes aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while developing its own board presence. The deck also benefits from the synergies between its creatures and spells, allowing it to adapt to various situations and outmaneuver opponents. Ultimately, the goal is to maintain control of the game while applying pressure and securing victory through efficient resource management and strategic gameplay.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful threats such as dragons and artifacts to lock down the opponent's resources. With a combination of fast mana acceleration, disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void, and big creatures like Karn, the Great Creator and Chandra, Torch of Defiance, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace opponents before they can establish their game plan. The aggressive nature of this deck makes it a formidable force in the Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quickly playing out all of its spells to fill up its graveyard with creatures and combo pieces, using cards like Dark Ritual, Simian Spirit Guide, and Lotus Petal for fast mana acceleration. The goal is to then use cards like Balustrade Spy or Undercity Informer to mill the entire deck, triggering Thassa's Oracle to win the game with a win condition in the graveyard. The deck is built around speed and efficiency in executing its combo, aiming to win the game as quickly as possible without relying on traditional creature combat.

The deck focuses on using cards like Entomb and Reanimate to quickly put powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield from the graveyard. It also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and interact with the opponent. The mana base includes powerful dual lands like Underground Sea and Polluted Delta to ensure the deck can cast its spells efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, using cards like Reanimate, Exhume, and Animate Dead. The deck utilizes various discard spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to disrupt the opponent's strategy and ensure the combo can go off smoothly. Additionally, cards like Entomb and Entomb help fill the graveyard with targets for reanimation. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, along with powerful removal like Swords to Plowshares. Stoneforge Mystic is used to search for equipment like Batterskull, providing a win condition while also benefiting from Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan. The deck's mana base allows for flexibility and consistency in casting spells, ensuring that the player can establish and maintain board control throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. Using instants like Lightning Bolt and Daze alongside disruptive cards like Wasteland and Force of Will, the deck aims to control the game's tempo while applying pressure on the opponent. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage. In essence, this deck focuses on fast and consistent threats to create a proactive game plan in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The deck is focused on quickly getting out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier by using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. It also includes protection cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to disrupt opponent's plans. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats early in the game while controlling the board with counterspells and card draw. The inclusion of cards like Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine and Archon of Cruelty provide additional utility and options for the player.

The deck utilizes the interaction between Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to mill the entire library, creating a win condition with Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. It also employs protection with Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card selection with Ponder and Brainstorm. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional ways to find combo pieces, with backup plans such as Narcomoeba and Nadu, Winged Wisdom. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single turn.

This Dragon Stompy deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays using powerful red creatures and disruptive enchantments to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With cards like Simian Spirit Guide and City of Traitors for quick mana acceleration, along with a suite of powerful dragons like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while dealing significant damage quickly. Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void help to shut down opposing strategies, while cards like The One Ring and Sundering Eruption provide additional ways to finish off the opponent.
